annotations.text: Any variant that moves the shelves down needs tap → push a screen instead of expanding in place: 294 settled rows can't unfold below the fold. Snoozed screen sorts by wake time, Settled groups by day.

Recommended: G. The shelves are built like thread rows (44pt tile, title, one line of detail, the same hairline), so they read as part of the list instead of a widget. H adds project stacks if you want a hint of what is inside. J is the most "designed" but a different language from the rest of Home.
